parameters.name: AliasName
parameters.description: The alias of the vulnerability to query.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Paging is used to display results.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Paging is used to display results. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The source of the whitelist. Valid values:
- **image**: image
- **agentless**: agentless.
